description.en: The HDMI Type A receptacle interface: a 19-contact, 0.5 mm-pitch opening 14.00 × 4.55 mm with two chamfered corners on one long side, taking a Type A plug one way up.
description.es: La interfaz del receptáculo HDMI Tipo A: una abertura de 19 contactos a paso de 0.5 mm, de 14.00 × 4.55 mm, con dos esquinas achaflanadas en un lado largo, que recibe una clavija Tipo A en una sola posición.
description.fr: L'interface de l'embase HDMI Type A : une ouverture à 19 contacts au pas de 0,5 mm, de 14,00 × 4,55 mm, avec deux coins chanfreinés sur un grand côté, qui reçoit une fiche Type A dans un seul sens.
description.pt: A interface do receptáculo HDMI Tipo A: uma abertura de 19 contatos com passo de 0,5 mm, de 14,00 × 4,55 mm, com dois cantos chanfrados num lado longo, que recebe uma ficha Tipo A num só sentido.

sources.title: Kycon KDMIX-NS2-NS-B15TR-2.1 HDMI Type A receptacle, SMT with through-hole shield, catalogue drawing
sources.supports: 19 positions at 0.50 ±0.05 pitch; opening (inside of the shell) 14.00 × 4.55, +0.05/−0.04; two chamfered corners on one long side of the opening; insertion force 44.1 N max

sources.title: Same Sky HD12-19-SMT-TR HDMI receptacle datasheet (2024-09-12)
sources.supports: 19 positions at 0.50 pitch; opening 14.00 × 4.55, +0.05/−0.04; shell outside at the front 14.80 × 5.35 (general ±0.20)

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the shell opening on the receptacle's front (mating) face. +z points out of the opening, toward a plug; +x runs along the opening's width; +y = z × x runs along its height, pointing from the long side with the two chamfered corners toward the plain long side. The body behind the face lies at z < 0.

opening_width.note: inside of the shell; Same Sky the same (source 1)

shell_width.note: outside, at the front; the sheet's general tolerance

interfaces.note: Female: a Type A plug enters the shell opening. Symmetry 1: the two chamfered corners admit it one way up. Framed on the shell's front face; the seated plug's position is not cited, so a mate seats it on this face, a convention.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The HDMI specification is available to adopters only, so the opening cites two receptacle makers' drawings, which agree; the chamfers are drawn but not dimensioned and are not stated. The body, legs and footprint vary by part and are not modelled.
